Nurse shortages and heavy workloads make it harder for teams to give timely care. Chasing providers or waiting for callbacks only adds delays and stress for everyone involved.

Is improving this kind of communication a focus for you right now? We could set up a call to discuss how it might work at Detroit Medical Center.  

Best Regards,  
Ayobami  
TigerConnect

Vena replaces manual work with automation inside Excel, while giving you data security and scenario modeling to keep planning agile and impactful.  

Would you be open to a short conversation on this?  

Thanks,  
Jack  
SDR | Vena
